journal_lines: Found something green in the old shaft. Not iron. Not copper. Something better.
The vein in the abandoned tunnel was not what anyone expected. Took it.
Deep in the old workings: green stone. Someone stopped digging too soon.
Emerald at the edge of the chamber, half-exposed. The wall had been protecting it.
Green so deep it pulled the eye. Took only what came free without forcing.
Someone had marked the wall with a chalk circle and walked away. Could not say why.
An old worker's name scratched into the timber, and beneath the timber the seam he never reached.
Carried the emerald wrapped in cloth. Did not want to scratch it on the way home.
